proposals.before: Anguo laughed and said, "He may be drowned now!
proposals.after: Anguo laughed and said, "You may urinate on them now!
proposals.reason: Chinese 溺 echoes Tian Jia's threat to urinate on dead ashes (s0026), not drowning.

proposals.before: Anguo laughed and said: "He may be drowned now!
proposals.after: Anguo laughed and said: "You may urinate now!
proposals.reason: Literal 溺 matches the urine joke of s0026, not drowning.

decisions.reason: In s0031 可溺矣, 溺 resumes Tian Jia’s s0026 threat 然即溺之 (“urinate on them”), not drowning; after Jia’s apology Anguo ironically invites him to do so, so “You may urinate on them now!” is accurate and natural.

s0031 溺 has the same sense as s0026 溺之 (urinate), not “drown”; the original “He may be drowned” is wrong, and “You may urinate now!” correctly renders the ironic invitation without inventing drowning.
